contract_findings.evidence: CreateSessionRequest has no sessionType field. Full mock versus practice is represented by selecting all versus a subset of snapshot task types in SetCompositionRequest.
contract_findings.resolution: No client-only session type was introduced.

contract_findings.evidence: The current SessionService does not reject invalid open/close transitions.
contract_findings.resolution: The client gates actions by authoritative status and implements typed 409 reload handling without changing pte-api.

findings.evidence: The initial widget test closed its BLoC while the submitted event was still completing, causing the test harness to wait indefinitely.
findings.resolution: Detached the widget and allowed the test-owned stream to terminate with the test; focused and full suites then completed.
